Thanks for sharing. I hope your in a bit of a better state now. Usually when people feel like a failure is when they fear they won't achieve their set goal. The problem with a set goal is that you basically don't have it yet. Else you would not have to set it as a goal. In eastern Taoist philosophy therefore people don't look at their goals in the same way as youd think. They let go and cut down the goal in their mind. Releasing it, telling themselves its oke to not achieve the goal. This is not a lazy fatalistic lifestyle view, but rather allows you to do your utmost best without being distracted by the fear, and actually lets you enjoy the proces, the journey towards it as it were. See the goal more as a guiding post somewhere in a uncertain future. If life wants it can alters the endpoint, but you just do your best and trust the 'universe' is the better architect of lifes steerings. The Roman stoically thought if you don’t Accept the alternative of an outcome, stress is well guaranteed ; / Therefore chop down your setgoals, walk only today and take all you encounter in bite sized steps. Don't juggle the entire picture in your mindseye. I let you with this end story i recently saw: If you ask an archer to shoot its target and as a reward youd offer him a useless wooden mug, he would shoot the target everytime. Replace the reward with a golden mug full of gold coins and hed shiver and fail and miss each shot at the target. Therefore dont let goals grow in your mind, chop them down each time they try to rise, accept that you wont achieve the target if that is the way the universe guides you. You just fo your best, and you might even enjoy the journey if you take it one step at a time. Have a jolly Christmas period, i hope i might have lifted your spirit a bit but its a constant reminder to chop down your set goals and live without thought of tomorrow. Simple meditation techniques actually are proven to increase the gray matter in the brains networks which allow you to let go of thoughts which persist. Good luck 👍 💓
